versions.content: If KeyM_Update() is called and KeyMCryptoKeyHandlerUpdateEnabled is set to FALSE and keyNameLength is 0, the crypto key submodule will interpret the input data as M1M2M3 values of a SHE key. The key_ID is extracted from M1 by extracting bit 121..124 of the input data and will search for the corresponding value in KeyMCryptoKeyCryptoProps to identify the KeyMCryptoKeyId and the associated CsmKeyRef. If found, the function will trigger the keyupdate operation.
